ModMetaData.name: Modular Power Armor
ModMetaData.author: Jitby-Jones
ModMetaData.description:
Install modifications into power armor the way you install bionics into pawns.
Every supported armor piece and helmet has a Computational Load stat. Each modification consumes some of that load, so you have to choose what each suit is built for. Modifications are crafted items with quality: every tier above or below Normal changes their effects by 15%.
Supported armor (each with its helmet and prestige version where one exists): - Marine, recon (Core) - Cataphract, locust, phoenix (Royalty) - Siegebreaker, trooper (Vanilla Armour Expanded) - Privateer (Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates) Armor from mods you don't have is skipped automatically.
11 modifications are included: 7 universal, 2 helmet-only and 2 body-only. Many of them show up on the pawn wearing them.
To install or remove a modification, use the "Modify armor" button on a colonist wearing modular armor, right-click a modification with a colonist selected, or right-click armor lying on the ground.
Combat Extended is fully supported: armor bonuses switch to mm RHA / MPa and some modifications gain CE-specific effects.
No Harmony required.
